The evaluation metrics include Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Mean Square Error (MSE).

The evaluation metrics include Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Mean Square Error (MSE). PCC is the primary evaluation metric, quantifying the linear correlation between predicted and ground-truth scores.
Each score was independently assigned by five experienced experts using the same rubrics, and the final score was determined by selecting the median value from the five scores.
